title: Work-tape positions visited along a choice sequence
statement: Let a nondeterministic machine have $k$ work tapes, and fix an input, an initial configuration, a finite Boolean choice sequence $w$, and a work-tape index $i$. The set of positions visited by tape $i$ consists of its head positions after running the machine from the initial configuration using each prefix of $w$, including the empty prefix and the full sequence.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
An initial configuration for that input
A work-tape index $i$ among the $k$ tapes
